signal_interruption: A signal executes save/exit, which contains none of these reporting calls. Success exits; failure unwinds to a still-active source trap or the next outer site. Registry catches may continue the original report but do not reinvoke its outer source site. Native callback/fatal dispatch effects remain an independent open obligation.

within_report.finally_wrapper: Fun.Finally_raised replaces the original with a primitive/save secondary; it does not add to a TypeMismatch wrapper chain.
within_report.registry_failure: Suppress secondary exception and continue with original input; do not recursively print the secondary inside the registry.
